Markets.title: IOC, BPCL, HPCL clock Rs 30,106 cr Q2 profit, nearly 39 pc of last year's annual earnings
Markets.summary: India's three major state-run fuel retailers—IOC, BPCL, and HPCL—reported a combined net profit of Rs 30,106 crore for the July-September quarter, reversing a previous loss of Rs 18,150 crore. This earnings surge occurred despite an ongoing freeze on petrol and diesel prices that began in May.

Markets.title: FPIs pull out Rs 34,843 cr from equities in Oct; turn net buyers last week
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities in October amid rising economic fears. However, they reversed course late in the month and injected approximately Rs 6,300 crore into the market.

Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian evacuees from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky have reunited with their families after enduring years without food, water, and electricity. During their time trapped, many residents were forced to cook garden weeds in order to survive.

Geo-Political.title: Judge dismisses Trump's lawsuit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday book

Data & Insights.summary: Between 2011 and 2023, the World Bank reported that India lifted 496 million people out of poverty. This reduction dropped extreme poverty from 27.1% to 2.6% through consumption growth, increased employment, and expanded social programs.

Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has formed a high-level banking panel led by Suresh N. Patel to review the nation's banking sector. The committee will recommend reforms to make the sector globally competitive, financially inclusive, and resilient by 2047.
